watch_out: Guest endpoints expire after 12 hours and allow only 25 requests; sign in for permanent Free endpoints. Requests over quota return HTTP 429; commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

name: Neocities Free
free_limit: 1 GB storage; 200 GB bandwidth; free neocities.org subdomain with HTTPS
watch_out: Static HTML/CSS/JS only. Custom domains, multiple sites, WebDAV and hotlinking are Supporter features; prohibited SEO-spam/fraud and third-party site generation restrictions apply. Commercial business sites are allowed under the AUP.

name: Tiiny Host Free
free_limit: 1 active site; 3 MB per-project upload (0.5 MB PDFs); 3 uploads/day; 5,000 visits and 5 GB bandwidth/month
watch_out: Log in at least once every 3 months to keep the site online. Free sites display a Tiiny Host banner; custom domains, API, analytics and larger uploads require paid plans. Commercial-use terms on Free are not explicitly confirmed.

name: Dynu Free Dynamic DNS
free_limit: 4 free hostnames, 4 own-domain hostnames, 4 subdomains, 4 custom DNS records and 4 web redirects; unlimited DNS queries; dynamic DNS updates
watch_out: Free account does not expire and requires no credit card. DNSSEC, HTTPS redirects, expanded hostnames/records and premium features require paid membership; own domains must be registered separately. Commercial-use permission for Free is not explicitly confirmed.

name: Swetrix Community Edition (Self-hosted)
free_limit: Free self-hosted Community Edition with core web analytics, custom events, funnels, performance monitoring and error tracking; no vendor-imposed hosted event quota; infrastructure is self-provided.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires Docker, Redis and ClickHouse; at least 2 GB RAM recommended. AGPL-3.0 license obligations apply, including network-use source sharing where required. Swetrix Cloud has no ongoing free plan (14-day card-required trial only).

name: Deno Deploy Free
free_limit: 1,000,000 requests/month; 20 GiB egress/month; 10 active CPU hours/month; 150 GiB-hours memory/month; 1 GiB KV storage; 5 custom domains; up to 10 active apps
watch_out: The full published Free allowance requires organization verification with a credit card; unverified organizations have restricted Free limits. Free apps pause when request/bandwidth/CPU/memory allowance is exceeded. This is new Deno Deploy, not discontinued Deploy Classic. Commercial eligibility of the Free plan needs provider confirmation.

name: Ackee Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted website analytics; no vendor-imposed limits on tracked sites, pageviews or events.
watch_out: Self-hosted only; requires Node.js and MongoDB. Hosting, storage, backups and maintenance may incur infrastructure costs. No managed free SaaS tier.

name: Offen Fair Web Analytics (Self-hosted)
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0-licensed self-hosted analytics; multiple websites per instance, no vendor-imposed pageview quota; built-in 6-month data retention.
watch_out: Self-hosted infrastructure and maintenance costs apply. Requires visitor opt-in; first-party cookies used. Original source is Apache-2.0, but the Offen icon/logo have CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 restrictions; check branding rights for commercial deployments.

name: Filestack Free
free_limit: 500 uploads/month; 1 GB managed storage; 1 GB delivery bandwidth; 1,000 transformations; 1 workflow; 1 team member; 20 MB maximum file size.
watch_out: Free plan has community support only. Upload count resets monthly; other allowance reset periods are not explicitly confirmed. Premium OCR, AI and enhancement add-ons are paid; overage fees may apply. Explicit commercial-use rights on the Free plan require confirmation.

name: Opik Free Cloud (Comet)
free_limit: 25,000 spans/month; up to 10 team members; 60-day data retention; agent tracing, evaluation suites and playground.
watch_out: Cloud data region is US. Additional spans are not included on Free; Pro Cloud is paid. Commercial-use terms for hosted Free are not explicitly confirmed; Ollie coding harness trial is separate from the ongoing Opik Free Cloud allowance.

name: PythonAnywhere Beginner Free
free_limit: 1 Python web app with 1 web worker, 512 MiB disk, 100 CPU-seconds/day for consoles, and 2 consoles; web app expires after 1 month unless renewed.
watch_out: Free web app uses a pythonanywhere.com subdomain; restricted outbound HTTP(S) allowlist; no SSH, scheduled tasks or MySQL for new accounts. Renew the web app monthly. No paid-tier features included.

name: AwardSpace Free Hosting
free_limit: 1 GB disk, 5 GB monthly bandwidth, 1 hosted domain and 3 subdomains, PHP and 1 MySQL database (30 MB); ad-free hosting.
watch_out: One free account per user; outbound connections and hotlinking disabled; 15 MB file upload limit, 25,000 inodes, restricted file types. Free hosting renews annually on human login and may be disabled for inactivity; provider recommends paid hosting for business websites.

name: Activepieces Cloud Free
free_limit: 1,000 credits/month; up to 5 users; unlimited flows; cloud-hosted automation, agents, tables, MCP and API access
watch_out: AI model steps use additional credits (2/10/20 per model tier); free quota pauses runs until credits refresh. Official pricing page inconsistently states daily vs monthly reset; verify reset timing. Cloud Free is distinct from self-hosted Community Edition; commercial-use terms not explicitly confirmed.

name: WorkOS AuthKit Free
free_limit: Up to 1,000,000 monthly active users for AuthKit user management and authentication, including email/password, social sign-in, passkeys and MFA.
watch_out: A payment card is required before using a production environment; staging can be tested without a card. Enterprise SSO and Directory Sync cost from $125 per connection/month, custom domains $99/month, and each additional 1 million MAUs $2,500/month. Avoid paid features and overages.

name: TiDB Cloud Starter Free (MySQL-compatible)
free_limit: Up to 5 free MySQL-compatible instances per organization; each includes 5 GiB row storage, 5 GiB columnar storage and 50 million Request Units per month.
watch_out: Free allowance applies separately to each of the first five eligible instances; at quota, new connections are blocked and existing sessions throttled until reset. Enabling paid overages or adding instances requires a credit card and spending limit. PostgreSQL-compatible public-preview quota is separate and not included. Commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

name: UptimeSignal Free
free_limit: 25 HTTP/API uptime monitors with 5-minute checks; 7-day uptime history; email alerts and hosted status pages.
watch_out: Free tier uses uptimesignal.io subdomains; custom domains, 1-minute checks and longer history require Pro. Official product pages disagree about whether Free includes one or unlimited status pages and about extra alert channels; verify in account before relying on them. Commercial use explicitly permitted.

name: Bruno Open Source API Client
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local-first API client and CLI for HTTP/REST, GraphQL and gRPC; unlimited collection runs, 2 workspaces, 5 OpenAPI syncs/month; API testing, scripting and local Git-friendly collections.
watch_out: Desktop/CLI software, not a hosted API service; no cloud sync or provider-hosted usage allowance. Advanced in-app Git actions, private Git-provider integration, unlimited workspaces and premium support require paid plans. Follow MIT license notices; external API and CI infrastructure costs are separate.

name: tunnl.gg Free
free_limit: 3 simultaneous HTTPS/WebSocket tunnels per IP; random URLs or SSH-key-bound stable URLs without signup; tunnels close after 2 hours idle or 24 hours maximum.
watch_out: Free tunnels show a browser safety warning; 50 requests/second per tunnel (burst 400), 25 requests/second per visitor (burst 200). Stable URLs require an SSH key; chosen subdomain names and unlimited session duration require Pro. Hosted free-tier commercial-use permission not explicitly confirmed.

name: Buildkite Free
free_limit: Up to 5 active users; 10 concurrent jobs; 2,000 Linux vCPU-minutes/month on Small hosted agents; 250,000 test executions/month; 50 GB artifact storage and 250 GB artifact downloads/month.
watch_out: Starts with a 30-day all-access trial; select the ongoing $0 Free plan afterward. Linux Small only on Free; 30-day build/artifact retention; self-hosted agents consume your own infrastructure. Commercial-use permission for Free not explicitly stated.

name: Fastly Compute Free Tier
free_limit: 10 million Compute requests and 100 million Compute vCPU milliseconds per month, included at no charge in the recurring free tier.
watch_out: Usage beyond either free allowance is billed automatically at published usage-based rates; Fastly signup requires a credit card for verification. Other products, data transfer and optional features may incur charges. Legacy pre-2026-03-31 Compute development trials are separate; confirm production and commercial-use terms before deployment.

name: Namecheap FreeDNS
free_limit: Free authoritative DNS for domains registered with other registrars; up to 150 DNS records per domain; Dynamic DNS, email forwarding and URL forwarding.
watch_out: Requires an existing third-party domain; domain registration is not included. Verify domain ownership and configure FreeDNS nameservers within 10 days. DNSSEC and premium SLA require PremiumDNS. Payment-card and commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed.

name: Proton Lumo Free
free_limit: Free AI chat with limited messages, Max-model usage and image generations; 1 Project; signed-in Free chat history retained for 7 days. No fixed numeric message quota published.
watch_out: Proton account required for saved Free-plan chats; guest chat works without signup but has tighter limits. Free usage caps are not numerically published. Lumo Plus and Lumo for Business are paid; commercial use of Free is not explicitly confirmed. Automated or bulk account creation is prohibited.

name: Tavily Researcher Free
free_limit: 1,000 API credits per month for Search, Extract, Crawl, Map and other supported API operations; credits reset on the first day of each month.
watch_out: Credits are shared across API operations and consumption varies by endpoint/depth. Free requests stop when credits are exhausted until the monthly reset; higher usage requires paid billing. Commercial-use rights for the free tier require confirmation.

name: Manticore Search Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free self-hosted open-source full-text, vector and hybrid search engine; no vendor-enforced query, document or seat quota for the open-source distribution.
watch_out: You provide and pay for compute, storage, backups, monitoring and operations. GPLv3-or-later obligations apply when redistributing covered software; managed cloud services and paid support are separate.

name: Arize AX Free
free_limit: 25,000 trace spans/month; 1 GB ingestion/month; 15-day retention; unlimited users and evaluations; Signal 10 issues/month.
watch_out: SaaS Free tier has span and ingestion quotas, short retention, one space and community support. Paid Pro starts at $50/month for higher limits; hosted Free commercial-use terms require confirmation.

name: HookGet Free
free_limit: 10,000 webhook deliveries/month; 1 project, 2 endpoints; 3-day retention; up to 25 publishes/second.
watch_out: Deliveries are counted per destination; fan-out to multiple endpoints consumes multiple deliveries. Payload usage is metered in 64 KB units. Free quota is a hard cap (publishing rejected, not billed). Hosted only; no published uptime SLA; commercial-use terms unconfirmed.

name: Codeberg Pages Free
free_limit: Free static website hosting from public Codeberg repositories; user, organization and per-repository sites on codeberg.page; custom domains supported.
watch_out: Codeberg is intended for free/libre software and freely licensed content; proprietary/commercial site eligibility requires provider-policy review. Repository storage guidance is 750 MiB Git and 100 MiB total non-promoted content; larger usage may require an exception. Pages migrated to git-pages; legacy v2 is unavailable to new users. Static sites only; deployment uses repository webhooks or Forgejo Actions.

name: Surge Free Static Hosting
free_limit: Unlimited static projects and publishes; free surge.sh subdomains, custom domains and managed SSL certificates; static CDN hosting.
watch_out: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript only; no backend runtime. Custom redirects, CORS controls, password protection and user-supplied SSL certificates require paid Surge Professional. Traffic/abuse policies and commercial-use rights require confirmation; custom domain registration itself is not included.

name: ConfigCat Forever Free
free_limit: 10 feature flags; 2 environments; 2 products; 5 million config JSON downloads/month; 20 GB network traffic/month; unlimited seats, service connections, MAUs and local flag evaluations.
watch_out: Free plan caps flags, environments, products, targeting rules and monthly CDN downloads/traffic; higher limits and advanced governance require paid plans. ConfigCat counts config JSON downloads rather than individual flag evaluations; commercial-use eligibility is not explicitly confirmed.

name: Statsig Developer Free
free_limit: 2 million metered events/month; unlimited feature flag and config checks; 50,000 session replays/month; unlimited seats.
watch_out: Developer has 1-year analytics retention and 30-day session replay retention; advanced approvals and higher quotas require Pro. Above 2M events, metric-lift computations stop while gate/config targeting continues; upgrading requires a card. Hosted commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

name: RustFS Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source, self-hosted S3-compatible object storage; no vendor-enforced monthly storage or request quota (capacity depends on your own infrastructure).
watch_out: Not a free managed cloud storage tier: servers, disks, bandwidth, backups, TLS, operations and support cost extra. Use Linux for production, replace default credentials before network exposure, and verify S3 feature compatibility and Apache-2.0 obligations.

name: Pinata IPFS Free
free_limit: 1 GB total storage; 500 files; 10 GB gateway bandwidth/month; 10,000 gateway requests/month; 1 gateway.
watch_out: Storage and file caps are total limits, while gateway bandwidth and requests reset monthly. Additional capacity, private files and advanced gateway features require paid plans. Free signup card requirement and hosted commercial-use terms are not independently confirmed.

name: blitz.cloud Free
free_limit: Up to 5 hosted apps; 512 MB RAM shared across apps; 10 GB storage; 1 managed PostgreSQL, MariaDB or Redis database; free blitz.cloud subdomains with HTTPS.
watch_out: Apps sleep after 30 minutes idle and wake on browser visits; webhooks/scheduled tasks cannot reliably wake them. Free excludes custom domains, search indexing and app-file backups. Background workers stop after 2 days without account activity. Provider may end Free with 14 days notice during startup phase through 31 March 2027; explicit Free commercial-use permission is unconfirmed.

name: Litlyx Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted web and product analytics with pageviews, real-time dashboards, custom events and funnels; no vendor-hosted monthly quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted only: operator pays for servers, database, updates, security and maintenance. Managed Litlyx Cloud pricing and free trials are separate, not an ongoing hosted free tier; Apache-2.0 license terms apply.

name: Google Cloud Tasks Free Allowance
free_limit: First 1,000,000 billable operations per month per Google Cloud billing account; HTTP task queue API calls and push delivery attempts (32 KB operation units).
watch_out: Active Google Cloud billing account and valid payment method required; operations over 1 million/month cost $0.40 per million, 32 KB chunking and retries count, and HTTP target network/compute can incur separate charges.

name: Zeplo Developer Free
free_limit: 500 queued or scheduled HTTP requests per month free forever; unlimited jobs; 1 developer; 30-day log retention.
watch_out: Requests beyond the free allowance are listed at $20 per 100,000; spending cap can limit charges. Card requirement for free signup and commercial production rights are not explicitly confirmed; Developer is positioned for development.

name: rqlite Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted distributed relational database built on SQLite, with HTTP/JSON API, Raft replication and high availability; no vendor-enforced database, query or monthly usage quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted software, not a managed free database: compute, disk, network, backups and operations are your responsibility. Multi-node high availability needs quorum; no hosted SLA. Preserve MIT copyright and license notices.

name: Casdoor Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted IAM/SSO; no per-user or monthly-active-user software fee; OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP and MFA supported.
watch_out: Self-hosted only: operate and secure your own servers, database, upgrades, backups and identity integrations; hosting, SMS/email and infrastructure may cost extra. Casdoor Cloud is paid after its time-limited trial/credit; do not confuse with the perpetual self-hosted edition.

name: VictoriaMetrics Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 single-node and cluster self-hosted metrics monitoring and time-series storage, with no vendor-enforced monthly ingestion, host, or seat quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own compute, disk, backups, security and operations. Enterprise-only features, managed VictoriaMetrics Cloud and support are paid; Cloud's 30-day trial is not a free plan.

name: Mockoon Open Source
free_limit: Unlimited local mock API servers, routes and requests using the free desktop app, CLI or Docker image; OpenAPI import/export and CI integration.
watch_out: Local-first MIT-licensed edition; infrastructure for remote deployment is self-funded. Real-time team collaboration, centralized administration, managed deployments and browser workspace require paid Mockoon Pro; its 14-day trial is not the free edition.

name: Jenkins Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed Jenkins core; self-hosted CI/CD pipelines, jobs and agents without vendor-imposed monthly build limits; capacity depends on your infrastructure.
watch_out: Requires self-managed controller, build agents, Java, security updates and infrastructure costs. Third-party plugins may use different open-source licenses; no managed compute or SLA included.

name: frp Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source frps/frpc reverse proxy for self-hosted TCP, UDP, HTTP and HTTPS tunnels; no vendor-imposed monthly tunnel, request or bandwidth quota.
watch_out: Requires your own publicly reachable server/VPS, connectivity and secure authentication; hosting, domain and bandwidth costs are not included. No managed free tunnel, hosted SLA or bundled infrastructure.

name: ApyHub Starter Free
free_limit: 3,000 atoms per month across the API catalog; 5 requests/second; 1 API key; 1 team member; MCP access.
watch_out: Atoms are not equivalent to API calls; each endpoint may consume a different amount. Traffic stops at the included quota unless upgraded or topped up; upstream API licenses and commercial rights vary, and Free has no paid-plan SLA.

name: MailerSend Free
free_limit: 500 transactional emails per month (up to 100 emails/day); 100 API requests/day; 1 sending domain, 1 API token, 1 webhook and 1 template.
watch_out: A credit card and account approval are required to activate Free, although the plan is $0. Sending pauses at the quota until reset; 14-day Professional trial is separate and downgrades to Free. Hosted Free commercial-use conditions require confirmation.

name: dynv6 Free Dynamic DNS
free_limit: Free IPv4/IPv6 dynamic DNS hostname or delegated own domain, with DNS record management and REST/DynDNS/SSH/TSIG update APIs; no numeric zone or query allowance published.
watch_out: No SLA or enterprise DDoS protection; unsuitable for critical services. Inactive accounts may be deleted, excessive API requests throttled, and the free service may change or end without guarantee. Commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed.

name: Azure Container Apps Consumption Free Grant
free_limit: 180,000 vCPU-seconds, 360,000 GiB-seconds and 2 million HTTP requests per Azure subscription per calendar month on the Consumption plan.
watch_out: Requires an Azure subscription and a supported payment method for standard signup; usage above monthly grants is billed. Idle replicas, networking, logs and other Azure services may incur charges. Set minimum replicas to zero to avoid idle compute charges; dedicated plans are separate.

name: Gemini Notebook Standard Free
free_limit: 100 notebooks per user and 50 sources per notebook; free source-grounded AI chat and notebook outputs with compute-based usage limits refreshing every five hours.
watch_out: Formerly NotebookLM. Generation quotas vary by task complexity, chat length, source count and feature; higher limits and some advanced tools require paid Google AI/Workspace plans. Regional availability, output watermarks and commercial-use terms should be checked.

name: SerpApi Free
free_limit: 250 successful searches per month across supported search APIs; maximum 50 successful searches per hour.
watch_out: Free tier is rate-limited; cached, errored and failed searches are not charged. Commercial use of the Free plan is not confirmed; SerpApi historically described a non-commercial Free plan, so verify current terms before production use. Higher quotas require paid plans.

name: OpenRouter Free Models
free_limit: 25+ free models with chat and API access; 50 free-model requests/day and 20 requests/minute without purchased credits; up to 5 workspaces.
watch_out: Free model availability and provider routing may change; failed requests count toward daily cap. Buying at least $10 credits raises free-model allowance to 1,000 requests/day. Free endpoints may retain prompts; commercial rights and output licenses depend on each underlying model/provider; no SLA.

name: LangWatch Developer Free
free_limit: 50,000 events/month; 2 users; 14-day data access; 3 scenarios, 3 simulations and 3 custom evals.
watch_out: Each LLM call, tool call, retrieval, evaluation or simulation step counts as an event. Developer has limited retention and evaluation quotas; paid Growth adds capacity. Commercial-use rights for hosted Developer require confirmation.

name: Hookdeck Outpost Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source outbound webhook and event-destination server, self-hosted with no vendor-enforced monthly event, delivery, tenant, or user quota; supports HTTP webhooks, queue/bus destinations, retries, fan-out and a customer portal.
watch_out: Self-hosted software, not Hookdeck's paid managed Outpost or the separate hosted Event Gateway Free plan. Requires your own compute, Redis, PostgreSQL, supported message queue, security, backups and operations; third-party destination services may charge. Apache-2.0 attribution applies; provider logos and trademarks are excluded.

name: NudgeHost Free Static Hosting
free_limit: 10 active hosted links/sites on a free account; up to 25 MB per file or uploaded site ZIP; 2 API keys at 20 requests/minute; no visitor cap; hosted HTML and ZIP sites stay live until deleted.
watch_out: A free account is required for permanent links; anonymous uploads expire after 7 days. Static HTML/CSS/JS hosting only, no server-side runtime. Custom domains and password protection require Pro; default site URLs may request no search indexing. Free is marketed for personal files, so commercial-use rights require confirmation.

name: GO Feature Flag Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted feature flag system with unlimited feature flags and no vendor-imposed seat, evaluation or monthly request limits; OpenFeature SDKs and stateless relay proxy.
watch_out: Self-host and maintain the relay proxy, configuration storage and any supporting infrastructure; hosting, monitoring and maintenance costs are not included. Dedicated enterprise support and security-response SLA are paid separately.

name: Byet Host Free Web Hosting
free_limit: 5 GB NVMe storage; unmetered bandwidth subject to fair use; PHP 8.3 and MySQL 8; free SSL for provider subdomains; custom domains and up to 10 MB file uploads.
watch_out: Free hosting is intended for personal sites and experiments. No uptime SLA; high resource use, bulk email, proxy services and download/file-sharing hosting are prohibited. Three free accounts maximum per person; users must maintain their own backups. Commercial-use eligibility is not explicit.

name: Valkey Self-Hosted
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause open-source in-memory key/value datastore for standalone or clustered self-hosting; no vendor-imposed instance, request, or storage quota.
watch_out: You must provision and secure your own servers, memory, storage, backups and operations; no hosted free instance or managed SLA is included.

name: Ceph Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free, open-source distributed object, block, and file storage on self-managed hardware; no vendor-imposed storage, request, or user quota.
watch_out: No managed storage capacity, hosting, or SLA is included. Supply and operate disks, servers, network, backups, monitoring and security; comply with LGPL 2.1/3.0 and bundled component licenses.

name: Cerbos PDP Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free-forever Apache-2.0 self-hosted policy decision point with YAML authorization policies, decision APIs, audit logs and Git/disk/cloud/DB policy storage; no vendor-enforced monthly decision or user quota.
watch_out: Requires your own hosting, security updates and operations. Cerbos Hub PoC has separate hosted limits (100 monthly active principals); Hub collaboration, managed policy delivery, enterprise features and support are not included.

name: Jaeger Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source distributed tracing backend with collector, query API and UI; self-hosted deployments have no vendor-imposed monthly trace, user or instance quota.
watch_out: Provide and operate your own compute, storage backend, backups and security. Default all-in-one in-memory storage loses traces on restart and is for development; production needs durable storage and appropriate scaling. No hosted free tracing service or managed SLA is included.

name: Rybbit Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted web and product analytics with pageviews, custom events, funnels and session replays; no vendor-imposed monthly event or pageview quota.
watch_out: Requires your own VPS (2 GB RAM or more recommended), domain with HTTPS, Docker, PostgreSQL and ClickHouse; hosting, backups and maintenance are not included. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply; optional anonymous instance telemetry can be disabled. Rybbit Cloud offers a 7-day trial, NOT an ongoing free cloud plan.

name: RabbitMQ Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Self-hosted RabbitMQ message broker under MPL-2.0, with queues, streams, AMQP messaging and no vendor-imposed message, queue or connection quotas.
watch_out: You supply servers, storage, backups, monitoring and upgrades; capacity is infrastructure-dependent. Community security patches and support are limited to currently supported release series; extended lifecycle and 24/7 vendor support require commercial Tanzu RabbitMQ. Distinct from CloudAMQP's managed Little Lemur tier.

name: EUserv VS2-free IPv6 VPS
free_limit: Free Linux container VPS with root access: 1 vCPU at 1 GHz, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB HDD, 1 IPv6 /128 and 1 TB traffic per month.
watch_out: IPv6-only (no included IPv4); connection throttled to 1 Mbit/s after 1 TB/month. One-month contract requires manual renewal; account verification and capacity/order availability apply. Paid IPv4, extras and licensed operating systems may cost money. Card and commercial-use terms not explicitly confirmed.

name: Woodpecker CI Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 CI/CD server and agents for self-hosted container-based pipelines; no vendor-imposed per-user, per-repository or build-minute quotas.
watch_out: Requires your own server, build agents, Docker-compatible execution infrastructure and Git forge integration; infrastructure, maintenance and any third-party services are not included.

name: bore Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted TCP tunnel client and server; no vendor-imposed tunnel count, bandwidth or session quotas on your own server.
watch_out: Requires your own publicly reachable server and infrastructure. TCP traffic is NOT encrypted by default (the optional shared secret authenticates only the handshake); use TLS or a VPN for sensitive traffic. No built-in HTTPS or HTTP hostname routing; public bore.pub relay is a separate best-effort service.

name: Semaphore Community Edition Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free open-source Apache-2.0 Community Edition for self-hosted CI/CD; run jobs on own infrastructure and agents; no vendor-hosted build-minute allowance.
watch_out: Requires self-hosting and infrastructure/agent costs; Community Edition lacks paid Enterprise features. No vendor-managed hosting included.

name: Modal Starter Free Compute
free_limit: $30/month recurring compute credit for CPU, memory and GPU workloads; up to 3 workspace seats, 100 containers, 10 concurrent GPUs, 5 scheduled crons and 1 TiB/month included network egress.
watch_out: Starter is $0/month plus metered usage: compute above $30/month and services outside the compute credit (including Shared Endpoints tokens) incur charges. Configure a workspace budget to control spending. Card requirement and unrestricted commercial use on Starter need confirmation.

name: Quad9 Public DNS
free_limit: Free public recursive DNS resolver with malware/phishing blocking, DNSSEC validation, DNS-over-HTTPS and DNS-over-TLS; no account or published monthly query quota for ordinary use.
watch_out: Recursive DNS only: does not host authoritative DNS zones or provide CDN. ISPs, service providers and other large organizations should contact Quad9 before sending large-scale DNS traffic; no business SLA or per-domain DNS management.

name: LibreChat Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted multi-provider AI chat and agent interface, with Docker Compose deployment and no vendor-imposed seat, message, or monthly usage quota for the self-hosted software.
watch_out: Operator supplies server/container resources and model access; paid model API usage, third-party services and hosting may incur costs. LibreChat does not bundle free model API credits; self-hosted setup requires MongoDB and other services.

name: Quickwit Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source search engine; no vendor-imposed search, indexing, or storage quotas for self-hosted software.
watch_out: Operator supplies and pays for servers, object storage, backups and operations; officially supported on Linux; Quickwit targets log/observability search, not managed hosted search.

name: vLLM Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source LLM inference and serving engine; unlimited self-hosted inference subject to own hardware capacity; no vendor-hosted free compute included.
watch_out: Requires own compute (typically supported GPU or CPU build), storage and model weights. Infrastructure and model downloads may cost money; each model has separate license and commercial-use restrictions; no free hosted API credits.

name: Smee.io Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook relay for development and testing; no software subscription or vendor-imposed usage quota; optional public hosted development channels.
watch_out: Development/testing only: not designed for production; channels are unauthenticated and anyone with the URL can inspect webhook payloads. Self-hosting and optional Redis/infrastructure incur costs; messages are forwarded to connected clients, not durably queued.

name: Coolify Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free forever self-hosted PaaS with unlimited app, database and service deployments, connected servers and team members; all software features included.
watch_out: Requires your own server/VPS and payment for infrastructure, storage, network and third-party services. Managed Coolify Cloud is paid; Apache-2.0 license applies to self-hosted software.

name: BullMQ Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted background-job queues and workers with no BullMQ OSS limit on workers or concurrency.
watch_out: Requires own Redis-compatible data store and worker compute (infrastructure may cost money); BullMQ Pro groups, batches, observables and support are paid and excluded.

name: DigitalOcean App Platform Static Sites Free
free_limit: Up to 3 static-site-only apps at $0/month; 1 GiB outbound transfer per app/month, automatic HTTPS, custom domains and CDN.
watch_out: Static components only; additional static-only apps cost $3/month and outbound transfer above 1 GiB/app costs $0.02/GiB. A payment method is required to create resources (cards and alternatives accepted); credit-card necessity and commercial-use permission not explicitly confirmed.

name: flagd Self-Hosted Feature Flags
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source feature-flag evaluation engine with local/remote flag sources, targeting rules, real-time updates and progressive rollouts; no vendor-imposed flag or evaluation quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only; provide your own compute, configuration and flag source. No built-in UI, management console or persistence layer. Operational infrastructure costs are separate.

name: Kopia Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source encrypted backup software; unlimited locally managed snapshots and backup policies; optional self-hosted server mode with web UI and API.
watch_out: Self-managed backups require local, network, or cloud storage at your own cost; cloud provider transfer/storage fees apply. Shared repositories use a single password and have no per-user repository ACL.

name: OpenBao Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MPL-2.0 open-source secrets and encryption management; self-hosted secret engines, identity-based policies, audit devices and HTTP API; no software license quotas.
watch_out: Requires self-managed infrastructure, secure TLS, unsealing, key recovery, access policies and backups; hosting/operations cost extra. MPL-2.0 source distribution obligations apply to modified covered files.

name: Metabase Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted business intelligence with unlimited users, questions and dashboards, a visual query builder and SQL editor, and connections to 20+ data sources.
watch_out: You provide and maintain the server, metadata database, backups and data-source connections. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply to modified/distributed versions and network use; advanced SSO, row/column security and white-label embedding are paid. Metabase Cloud is not a free ongoing plan.

name: Apache SkyWalking Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source observability/APM platform with distributed tracing, metrics, logs, service maps, alerting, backend and web UI; no vendor software quotas for self-hosting.
watch_out: Self-managed Java OAP server, agents, UI and persistent storage (such as BanyanDB) require infrastructure and maintenance. Quickstart/default storage is not a production deployment; production needs appropriate storage, security and clustering. No managed cloud allowance is included.

name: QuestDB Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source time-series SQL database with high-throughput ingestion, Parquet support and a built-in web console; no vendor-imposed software quotas or license fee.
watch_out: You supply compute, storage, backups and operational security. High availability/replication, role-based access control, TLS, audit logs and automated tiering are Enterprise features; the Enterprise trial is not an ongoing free tier.

name: Mailpit Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local/self-hosted SMTP capture and email-testing server with a web inbox, message search, REST API, HTML/link checks and Docker or single-binary deployment; no vendor software quota.
watch_out: For development and staging email testing, not a managed email delivery provider. Default automatic pruning retains the latest 500 messages; protect the SMTP and web UI with authentication/network controls, especially when using optional relay/forwarding. You operate any hosting infrastructure.

name: Apache Superset Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0-licensed self-hosted data exploration and visualization platform with SQL Lab, charts, dashboards, database connectors and role-based access; no vendor software usage quota.
watch_out: You operate and pay for compute, metadata database, cache and any connected data services. Official Docker Compose quickstart is not production-ready; production requires hardened configuration, backups and an appropriate deployment (for example Kubernetes). Database drivers may require separate installation.

name: Tekton Pipelines Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0-licensed Kubernetes-native CI/CD framework with reusable Tasks, Pipelines, PipelineRuns and container-based execution; no vendor software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Kubernetes cluster, compute, container registry, storage and maintenance. Tekton is a framework rather than a turnkey hosted CI service; configure RBAC, secrets, task provenance and triggers separately. Infrastructure and external services may incur costs.

name: Dagger Engine Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0-licensed open-source CI/CD automation engine for local or self-hosted container-based build, test and delivery pipelines, with multi-language SDKs, caching and tracing; no vendor software usage quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own Linux container runtime and compute; you pay for infrastructure and external services. Dagger Cloud remote engines, distributed caching, access control and hosted observability are separately billed; this entry covers only the open-source engine.

name: Headscale Self-Hosted
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause open-source self-hosted Tailscale-compatible coordination server for a single tailnet; no vendor-imposed device, user or traffic quota for the software.
watch_out: Runs on your own server; designed for self-hosters and small organisations, not an enterprise-scale Tailscale SaaS replacement. Requires compatible Tailscale clients and self-managed HTTPS, upgrades and optional relay infrastructure; hardware and network costs apply.

name: OpenZiti Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-managed zero-trust overlay network with controllers, edge routers, identity-based policies, tunnelers and SDKs; no vendor-imposed seat or traffic quota for the OSS software.
watch_out: Operators must host and maintain controllers, routers, PKI, identities and network connectivity; infrastructure and operations cost extra. NetFoundry hosted, managed and commercially licensed management/support products are separate paid offerings.

name: Blocky DNS Proxy Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted DNS proxy with DNS-over-HTTPS/TLS upstreams, configurable blocklists, per-client rules, caching and Prometheus metrics; no vendor software query quota.
watch_out: Requires self-managed server, upstream DNS resolvers and network access; upstream provider limits and infrastructure costs may apply. Primarily a forwarding proxy, not a managed authoritative DNS service; configuration is YAML-based.

name: Technitium DNS Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free GPL-3.0 self-hosted authoritative and recursive DNS server with web console, DNS-over-HTTPS/TLS/QUIC and blocklists; no vendor-imposed query or zone quota for the software.
watch_out: Self-hosting, DNS/network bandwidth, domain registration and operations are not included. Secure the admin console and public resolver against abuse; GPL-3.0 distribution obligations apply when redistributing modified software. Not a managed free DNS hosting plan.

name: Fission Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 Kubernetes-native serverless framework for HTTP and event-triggered functions, autoscaling and custom runtimes; no vendor-imposed execution or function-count quota for the self-hosted software.
watch_out: Requires an existing self-managed Kubernetes cluster and ongoing compute, networking, storage and operations costs. This is software for running your own functions, not a hosted FaaS free allowance; external services and infrastructure may charge separately.

name: AnythingLLM Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted Docker AI workspace with document chat/RAG, configurable LLM providers, agents and developer API; no vendor-imposed chat or document quota for the core software.
watch_out: Runs on your own compute and storage. Local model hardware, paid cloud LLM APIs, vector databases and managed AnythingLLM Cloud plans are separate costs. Secure internet-facing instances, review third-party model licenses and disable optional telemetry if desired.

name: Knative Serving Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 Kubernetes serverless serving layer for request-driven containers, automatic scale-to-zero, traffic splitting and revision management; no vendor-imposed application or request quota for the open-source software.
watch_out: Requires a self-managed Kubernetes cluster, compatible networking/ingress and compute capacity; infrastructure, storage, logging and operations can cost money. This is not a hosted cloud free tier. Knative Eventing and Functions are separate components with their own setup.

name: Vespa Search Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Vespa search and vector retrieval software for self-managed deployments, with no vendor-enforced query, index-size, or seat quota.
watch_out: You provide compute, persistent storage, operations, backups and security; local Docker setup requires at least 4 GB RAM. Internal protocols are not authenticated by default: isolate hosts and configure access controls/TLS. Vespa Cloud is a separate managed service.

name: Sonic Search Self-Hosted
free_limit: MPL-2.0 open-source lightweight search backend with full-text term indexing, autocomplete, and typo correction; self-hosted software has no vendor-enforced query, document, or seat quota.
watch_out: Sonic stores a term index and returns object identifiers, not full source documents; your application must retain source records separately. Operate and back up its RocksDB store yourself; no built-in clustering or automatic failover. Hosting costs are separate.

name: OpenFlagr Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Flagr service for feature flags, A/B experiments, dynamic configuration, and API-based variant evaluation; no vendor-imposed seat or evaluation quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: You operate and pay for compute, database, backups, security, and availability. SQLite is suitable for a local demo; production deployments should configure a persistent MySQL/PostgreSQL database and TLS. Hosted demo is not a production service.

name: Apache OpenWhisk Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source event-driven serverless platform for running functions and triggers on self-managed Docker or Kubernetes infrastructure; no vendor-imposed function invocation or seat quota.
watch_out: You operate and pay for compute, containers, orchestration, persistent services, logs, security and backups. OpenWhisk deployment requires platform configuration; any third-party cloud infrastructure and connected services are billed separately.

name: Dokku Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed, Docker-powered self-hosted PaaS for Git-push application deployments and lifecycle management on your own Linux server; no vendor-imposed application, deployment or seat quota in the core software.
watch_out: Not free managed hosting: supply and pay for Linux server, Docker, persistent volumes, networking, TLS, backups and operations. Core deployment is managed with CLI/SSH; plugins, hosting and connected services may have separate requirements or costs.

name: OpenFGA Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source fine-grained authorization server supporting relationship-based and attribute-based access control via HTTP/gRPC APIs; no vendor-imposed authorization-check or seat quota for self-hosted software.
watch_out: Provide and secure your own compute, persistent database, backups, TLS, monitoring and availability. In-memory storage is for development; use PostgreSQL or MySQL for production. Managed authorization offerings and infrastructure cost extra.

name: JuiceFS Community Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source POSIX-compatible distributed file system backed by your own object storage and metadata engine; no vendor-enforced monthly storage, file or request quota in the community software.
watch_out: JuiceFS is not free managed storage: you pay for underlying S3-compatible object storage, metadata database (such as Redis or MySQL), compute, network, backups and operations. Commercial/enterprise edition is separate; anonymous usage telemetry is enabled by default and can be disabled.

name: Gatus Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted status page with configurable HTTP, TCP, ICMP and DNS health checks, conditions and alerting; no vendor-enforced endpoint or check quota for self-managed software.
watch_out: Self-hosted edition requires your own server, configuration, persistent storage, alert integrations, TLS and backups. Third-party alert channels may charge; Gatus.io managed status pages are a separate hosted product. No managed uptime SLA is included.

name: KServe Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes inference platform for predictive and generative AI models, with standardized inference APIs and optional Knative scale-to-zero; no vendor-imposed model-serving request or seat quota in the self-hosted software.
watch_out: You supply and pay for Kubernetes nodes, GPUs/CPUs, storage, network, observability, backups and model downloads; model weights have separate licenses. Knative-based serverless mode requires additional cluster components. No managed inference compute is included.

name: Bucketeer Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted feature flag management and A/B experimentation with unlimited team members, environments and evaluations; no vendor software seat or evaluation quota.
watch_out: You operate and pay for MySQL, Redis, compute, storage, TLS, backups and any Kubernetes/cloud integrations. Docker Compose Lite is for smaller deployments; production requires proper security and operational setup. No managed hosting included.

name: Asynq Self-Hosted (Go Redis Task Queue)
free_limit: MIT-licensed Go library for Redis-backed distributed background tasks, worker concurrency, retries, delayed/periodic scheduling and priority queues; no vendor-imposed task, worker or monthly execution quota for self-managed use.
watch_out: Requires your own Go application workers and Redis-compatible broker, plus compute, monitoring, backups and operations. At-least-once task execution requires idempotent handlers; not a hosted queue or free Redis instance. Asynq API is pre-1.0 and Redis Cluster compatibility requires review.

name: Svix Webhook Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Rust webhook delivery server with message signing, retries, endpoint management and delivery handling; no vendor-enforced monthly webhook or endpoint quota for the open-source server.
watch_out: Requires self-operated PostgreSQL, server/worker compute, network, backups and optional Redis; Docker Compose is a development-friendly deployment, not managed hosting. Open-source server differs from hosted Svix in some features and optimizations; hosted Svix Free is a separate catalog entry.

name: Wasmer Edge Hobby Static Hosting
free_limit: Hobby plan is advertised as free forever with static-site deployment, 150 GB bandwidth, 1 GB volume/package storage, 1 million requests and 1,000 build minutes per month; custom domains and managed HTTPS/SSL supported.
watch_out: Shared Hobby limits also cover app compute (6 active CPU hours), memory and other resources; usage above allowances may incur listed charges or require upgrade. Card requirement and commercial-use eligibility for the Hobby plan are not independently confirmed; verify before production use.

name: Dolt SQL Database Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted SQL database compatible with MySQL clients, supporting Git-style branching, commits, diffs and merges of versioned tables; no vendor-enforced database size, query or seat quotas in the open-source server.
watch_out: Requires your own CPU, RAM, disk, backups and database operations. DoltHub sharing, Hosted Dolt and managed support are separate offerings; Git-style version control changes performance and storage considerations versus conventional MySQL.

name: Graphile Worker Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed Node.js PostgreSQL-backed background job queue with task scheduling, retries, concurrency and PostgreSQL transaction integration; no vendor-enforced job, worker or monthly execution quotas when self-managed.
watch_out: Requires your own Node.js worker processes and PostgreSQL database; database, CPU, storage, backups and monitoring are not included. Tasks run at least once, so handlers should be idempotent; Graphile Worker is not a managed queue or free PostgreSQL service.

name: Hoppscotch Community Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Community Edition API development platform for HTTP, REST, GraphQL and WebSocket testing, API collections and collaboration; no vendor subscription, request or seat quota for the community software.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own application server, database, authentication setup, backups, TLS and ongoing security maintenance. Enterprise-only features (such as advanced SSO and audit logging) and hosted Cloud plans are separate; commercial use permitted under MIT license.

name: GoCD Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source continuous delivery server and build agents; self-hosted pipelines without a software license fee.
watch_out: You operate and secure the GoCD server and agents; compute, storage, plugins and supporting infrastructure are not included.

name: CoreDNS Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source DNS server with configurable plugins for forwarding, caching, zone serving and Kubernetes service discovery; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires DNS configuration, port 53 access and ongoing security/availability management; infrastructure, upstream DNS and cloud costs are not included.

name: Concourse CI Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source container-based CI/CD automation with declarative pipelines, resources, jobs and workers; no license-based job quota.
watch_out: Requires self-managed web and worker nodes plus PostgreSQL; container runtime, infrastructure, maintenance and secrets security are your responsibility.

name: Pinggy Free
free_limit: Free-for-life HTTP(S), TCP, UDP and TLS tunnels; unlimited data transfer with a 60-minute timeout per tunnel and random subdomains.
watch_out: Free tunnel URLs change when restarted or after the 60-minute timeout; persistent tunnels, custom domains/subdomains and priority support require paid Pro. Provider does not clearly state commercial-use eligibility for hosted Free.

name: localhost.run Forever Free
free_limit: Forever-free SSH-based HTTPS tunnels without signup or client download; short-lived free subdomains with rate-limited transfer.
watch_out: Free domain names rotate and throughput is speed-limited; persistent named domains and faster transfers require paid plans. Provider does not clearly specify commercial-use eligibility for free hosted tunnels.

name: Nuclio Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source event-driven serverless function framework; run functions with HTTP and data-stream triggers on self-managed Docker or Kubernetes, including CPU/GPU workloads.
watch_out: Requires a self-managed Docker host or Kubernetes cluster, image builds and registry, secure network configuration and operations; compute/GPU/storage and infrastructure are not included. Commercial managed Nuclio services are separate.

name: Argo CD Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 GitOps continuous delivery for Kubernetes, with declarative application synchronization, drift detection, rollback and multi-cluster deployment.
watch_out: Requires a self-managed Kubernetes cluster, Git repository access, secured credentials and ongoing operational maintenance; cluster and infrastructure costs are not included. Managed commercial distributions are separate.

name: Jan Local AI Assistant
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 desktop AI assistant for Windows, macOS and Linux; run supported open-weight language models locally and offline, or connect optional external model providers. No Jan software seat or message quota.
watch_out: Local inference requires sufficient CPU/GPU, RAM and disk space; downloaded model weights have separate licenses and commercial-use conditions. Optional hosted model APIs can charge fees. Attribution requested where appropriate.

name: Piku Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed micro-PaaS for git-push deployment of multiple apps to your own Linux/Unix server, with Procfile workers, virtual hosts and optional HTTPS; no Piku software usage or seat limits.
watch_out: You provide and secure your own server, SSH access, Python, nginx and uWSGI; compute, bandwidth, storage, DNS and TLS operations are not included. Best suited to small self-managed deployments.

name: ZincSearch Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 full-text search engine you can self-host, with schema-less indexing, REST APIs, bulk ingestion, a built-in UI and disk-backed indexes; no software query or index quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted compute, disk, backup, access control and maintenance are your responsibility. The project documents no built-in high availability; Elasticsearch API compatibility is partial and not a drop-in Kibana replacement.

name: Temporal Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed durable workflow orchestration server for self-managed deployments; run application workflows, activities, task queues and retries without Temporal software usage fees or managed-cloud quotas.
watch_out: Requires operating and securing the Temporal cluster, workers and persistence database (for example PostgreSQL or MySQL); high availability, backups, monitoring and infrastructure incur costs. Temporal Cloud is a separate paid service.

name: GPT4All Local AI
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local AI chat desktop application and developer bindings; download supported models, chat privately offline and use LocalDocs or a local API server without GPT4All software message or token fees.
watch_out: Model weights have separate license and commercial-use terms; large downloads, RAM/CPU/GPU and disk space are required. Optional integrations and cloud services may have separate costs; local app is not a managed hosted API.

name: Featurevisor Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed Git-based feature flags, A/B experiments and remote configuration; unlimited definitions evaluated locally by SDKs using self-hosted static JSON datafiles.
watch_out: Requires your own Git repository, CI build and hosting/CDN for generated datafiles; no managed dashboard or hosted allowance. Infrastructure and delivery costs are separate; retain MIT license notices.

name: Knock Developer Free
free_limit: 10,000 notification messages/month, 500 guide active users/month and 500 AI agent credits/month; unlimited workflows, broadcasts, delivery channels and team members.
watch_out: A message counts per recipient and channel; sending through email/SMS/push providers can incur their own charges. Developer tier is for evaluation or small-scale deployments; Knock does not hard-cap overages and may request billing setup if usage exceeds the free allowance.

name: Dex OIDC Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted OpenID Connect identity and OAuth 2.0 provider with pluggable LDAP, SAML, GitHub and other upstream identity connectors; no software usage or seat fee.
watch_out: Dex federates to upstream identity providers rather than replacing user directories; configure TLS, secure token signing keys, storage and identity connectors yourself. Upstream identity services and hosting may charge separately.

name: Shynet Self-Hosted Analytics
free_limit: Apache-2.0 privacy-focused web analytics for multiple websites and users, with pageviews, sessions, referrers and device metrics; self-hosted without software usage fees or monthly tracking quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own server with Django and a database; configure HTTPS, backups, updates and privacy compliance yourself. JavaScript tracking is optional with a pixel fallback; no managed cloud hosting or support is included.

name: MLflow Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source ML/GenAI experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation and tracing; no software license, seat or experiment quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: Operate and secure your own tracking server, database and artifact storage; cloud infrastructure and third-party model/API calls are not included. This is not a managed hosting allowance.

name: Netdata Agent Self-Hosted
free_limit: GPLv3+ open-source real-time host and container monitoring Agent, free on unlimited self-hosted nodes; local dashboard available under NCUL1.
watch_out: Run your own monitoring infrastructure. Netdata Cloud Community is a separate personal/non-commercial plan capped at 5 active connected nodes; Cloud Business and enterprise features are not included.

name: BentoML Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 framework for packaging and serving AI/ML model inference APIs, batch jobs and multi-model pipelines; no software license fee or per-model quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: Supply and pay for your own CPU/GPU, network and model storage; model weights may have separate licenses. BentoCloud managed compute is not included; anonymous framework usage telemetry can be disabled.

name: OpenTelemetry Collector Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source telemetry pipeline to receive, process and export traces, metrics and logs without per-host or telemetry volume license charges.
watch_out: Collector is a pipeline, not a hosted storage/search dashboard; provide your own telemetry backend, compute and network. Individual collector components have differing stability levels.

name: SeaTable Cloud Free
free_limit: Up to 25 users, unlimited bases/tables, 10,000 total rows, 2 GB file storage, 3,000 API calls/month and one month of snapshots.
watch_out: Limits are shared per team; paid Plus/Enterprise needed for higher row/storage/API allowances and advanced features. Separate self-hosted server plans have different user limits.

name: SigNoz Community Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free open-source community observability platform for logs, traces, metrics, dashboards and application performance monitoring on self-managed infrastructure.
watch_out: Operate your own Docker/Kubernetes deployment and ClickHouse storage; advanced enterprise features and support are separate. SigNoz Cloud offers a 30-day trial, not an ongoing free cloud plan.

name: Nextcloud Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: AGPLv3+ open-source file sync, sharing, WebDAV and collaboration server with no software license fee or fixed per-user storage allowance when self-hosted.
watch_out: Provide and secure your own disk, server, database, backups and TLS; storage is limited by your infrastructure. Some apps, enterprise support and hosted plans cost extra; AGPL obligations apply.

name: GitBook Free
free_limit: Free hosted public documentation for one individual editor, GitHub/GitLab sync, interactive API documentation, previews and unlimited public page views.
watch_out: Custom domains, additional collaborators, AI Assistant and analytics require paid plans; the 14-day trial shown for Essential/Ultimate is separate from Free.

name: Postman Free
free_limit: Free individual API client and core development tools, collections/environments, API specs and mock servers, native Git, manual Flows and collection runner.
watch_out: Designed for individuals; paid Solo/Team plans add automation, collaboration and expanded API monitoring. AI credits, mock-server usage and cloud queries have separate plan limits.

name: Mintlify Starter Free
free_limit: Free hosted documentation site with 5 editor seats, Git sync, a custom domain, web editor, search, MCP server and API playground.
watch_out: Pro AI Assistant/Agent, automations, preview deployments and advanced security are paid; 14-day Pro trial credits are not part of the ongoing Starter allowance.

name: Gitea Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-managed Git service with unlimited users and repositories; includes Git hosting, pull requests, issues, package registry and Gitea Actions CI/CD with self-hosted runners.
watch_out: No vendor-hosted CI minutes or compute are included; you operate and secure the server, storage and Actions runners. Enterprise support, SAML SSO and advanced features are paid. This is not the separate Gitea Cloud free trial.

name: PowerDNS Authoritative Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free GPL-2.0 licensed authoritative DNS server with DNSSEC, zone management, API automation and zone-file or database backends; no vendor-imposed software query or zone quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted authoritative DNS requires your own public servers, DNS delegation, networking, updates and monitoring; infrastructure and optional vendor support are not included. PowerDNS Recursor and dnsdist are separate products.

name: Forgejo Actions Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free GPL-3.0-or-later self-hosted Git forge with integrated Forgejo Actions CI/CD workflows, repositories, pull requests and issues; no vendor-imposed software build-minute quota.
watch_out: You must provide, configure and secure your own Forgejo instance and Actions runners; runner compute, storage and network costs are not included. Forgejo Actions is not guaranteed compatible with GitHub Actions and GPL obligations apply when redistributing modified binaries.

name: DocsGPT Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted document-grounded AI agents and assistants, knowledge ingestion, cited answers, workflows and local-model support; no software license or seat fee for self-hosting.
watch_out: Bring your own compute, storage, embeddings and language models. Paid cloud/managed/enterprise offerings and third-party model API usage are separate; review model and connector licenses and secure deployments.
